question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of hydrogen pipelines in operation or planned in the United States, with operator, capacity and status?

answer.summary: PHMSA's NPMS has restricted GIS data for reported hydrogen transmission lines. Texas RRC offers public line geometry. Its name filter identifies candidate hydrogen segments and can miss or misclassify lines. PHMSA annual reports give operators and mileage without routes. Capacity per pipeline was not verified. Angeles Link documentation contains preliminary corridors.
main_caveats: PHMSA limits access to the NPMS GIS data. Its public viewer shows county-level selections.
Texas RRC files hydrogen as 'OTHER GAS'; hydrogen lines are identified only by names containing H2/HYDROGEN, so some lines may be missed or mixed with other gases.
Capacity per pipeline was not found in the sources checked. Diameter and annual operator volume measure different attributes.
Angeles Link materials show preliminary corridors. CPUC decision D.26-04-034 denied ratepayer cost recovery for Phase 2 engineering and design studies.
Blends (Hawaii SNG with 10-12% H2 in service; California pilots of 0.1-20% pending) are not dedicated hydrogen pipelines; no US conversion of a gas line to 100% hydrogen was found.
answer.confidence_reason: Texas, PHMSA, NPMS and Louisiana checks were tested; PHMSA and operator sites block automated clients (PHMSA data read from an archived ZIP); IEA contents and planned projects outside California remain unverified.

attributes.note: Texas RRC has mapped lines that can be screened for hydrogen and checked with the RRC inventory. OSM has uneven coverage. Angeles Link shows preliminary corridors.
attributes.gap_note: Nationwide geometry is in NPMS (HG) but restricted to government/operators; no public layer for Louisiana (DCE links maps to NPMS) or other states.

attributes.note: National operator list from PHMSA reports; operator per segment only in Texas (RRC) and OSM; SoCalGas for Angeles Link.
attributes.gap_note: Operator per segment outside Texas is in NPMS, restricted; PHMSA reports give operator per report, not per pipeline.

attributes.note: Only a planned system design throughput (Angeles Link 1.5 MMT/Y). RRC gives diameter, PHMSA annual volume per operator; neither is capacity.
attributes.gap_note: No capacity field in RRC layer/list, NPMS dictionary or PHMSA form (Part C is volume transported); operator pages give network totals only.

attributes.note: Texas: In Service/Abandoned (layer), Active/Idle (list). Planned and blends: CPUC dockets (Angeles Link, pilots) and Hawaii PUC (10-12% H2 blend in service).
attributes.gap_note: NPMS status codes nationwide are restricted; IEA list of planned projects needs a login; no national list of planned lines opened.

sources.name: Railroad Commission of Texas pipeline layer (T-4 permitted pipelines): public ArcGIS map service and county shapefiles
sources.publisher: Railroad Commission of Texas (RRC), Pipeline Permitting & Mapping
sources.format: ArcGIS REST MapServer layer (JSON/GeoJSON); county ZIP shapefiles pipelineNNN.zip (NAD27 geographic)
sources.summary: Texas only: statewide ArcGIS service and county shapefiles with line geometry, operator, diameter, T-4 permit and In Service/Abandoned status; hydrogen is identified by 'H2'/'HYDROGEN' in system names. RRC's separate 'Hydrogen Pipelines' PDF (2026-09-18: 52 intrastate accounts, 481.36 mi, Active/Idle) joins by T-4 permit.
sources.coverage_note: 928 Texas segments matched (about 993 mi, 13 counties) on 2026-11-27, incl. interstate Air Products and Linde lines; no capacity, no planned lines.
caveats: Hydrogen filed as 'OTHER GAS' (OGT); name filtering is needed and imperfect.
RRC states GIS maps may not be used for pipeline location purposes.

example.example_request: curl -sG "https://gis.rrc.texas.gov/server/rest/services/rrc_public/RRC_Public_Viewer_Srvs/MapServer/13/query" --data-urlencode "where=COMMODITY='HYDROGEN' OR ((SYSTEM_NAME LIKE '%HYDROGEN%' OR SUBSYSTEM_NAME LIKE '%HYDROGEN%' OR SYSTEM_NAME LIKE '%H2%' OR SUBSYSTEM_NAME LIKE '%H2%') AND COMMODITY='OTHER GAS')" --data-urlencode "returnCountOnly=true" --data-urlencode "f=json"
example.example_result: {"count":928}. With outFields and outSR=4326&f=geojson, e.g. OPERATOR "AIR LIQUIDE LARGE INDUST U.S. LP", SYSTEM_NAME "EAST TEXAS HYDROGEN", SUBSYSTEM_NAME "EAST TEXAS 20 INCH HYDROGEN", DIAMETER 20, T4PERMIT "08531", INTERSTATE "No", STATUS "In Service", COUNTY_NAME "JEFFERSON", LineString starting [-93.98838, 29.88017].

sources.name: PHMSA Gas Transmission & Gathering Annual Report data (Form PHMSA F 7100.2-1), commodity group 'Hydrogen Gas'
sources.publisher: U.S. DOT Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety
sources.format: ZIP with yearly XLSX (2010-2025) and CSV per form Part (2017-2025) plus data-field PDFs
sources.summary: National census of hydrogen pipeline operators: 33 CY2025 reports with commodity 'Hydrogen Gas', 1,612 transmission miles, states served and annual volume; no geometry, no capacity.
sources.coverage_note: All states; Air Products, Linde and Air Liquide hold about 89% of hydrogen miles. Live site blocks automated clients; figures read from the 2026-05-08 archived ZIP.
caveats: Part C volume is annual throughput per operator, not capacity, and contains implausible values.

problems: Live www.phmsa.dot.gov page and ZIP return 403 'Access Denied' (Akamai) to automated clients, with and without www.

sources.name: National Pipeline Mapping System (NPMS): gas transmission pipeline GIS with commodity code HG (hydrogen gas)
sources.publisher: U.S. DOT PHMSA, National Pipeline Mapping System
sources.format: GIS data request (government only); Public Map Viewer web map
sources.summary: National official geometry of operating hydrogen transmission lines (commodity HG) with operator and status, but GIS data go only to government agencies and operators.
sources.coverage_note: Nationwide; public viewer is per county behind reCAPTCHA, accuracy +/-500 ft, no capacity, no planned lines.
caveats: Restricted since 2001 for security reasons; not downloadable by the public.

problems: GIS data restricted to government agencies and operators; Public Map Viewer loads Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise and shows one county per session.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap pipelines tagged substance=hydrogen (Overpass API)
sources.summary: Non-official line geometry: 204 OSM ways tagged substance=hydrogen with operator; 186 in Texas, none in Louisiana.
sources.coverage_note: Contiguous US box queried 2026-11-27 (Texas 186, Louisiana 0); completeness and status not documented.
caveats: Community data under ODbL; no capacity or lifecycle status.

problems: overpass-api.de answers 406 Not Acceptable to curl's default client; the same query works from another HTTP client.

example.example_result: {"type":"count","tags":{"nodes":"0","ways":"204","relations":"0","total":"204"}}; operator stats: Linde 36 + Linde Inc. 38, Air Products LLC 29 + Air Products 16 + Air Products and Chemicals Inc. 3, Air Liquide variants 34, Equistar 7, Phillips 66 5.

sources.name: State public utility commission records on planned hydrogen pipelines and hydrogen blends (California CPUC dockets, Hawaii PUC report)
sources.publisher: State public utility commissions (California PUC; Hawaii PUC)
sources.format: Docket web pages and PDF filings
sources.summary: California's CPUC denied recovery of Phase 2 study costs for Angeles Link in D.26-04-034. Other filings cover blending pilots in California and an operating blend in Hawaii.
sources.coverage_note: CPUC A.24-12-011 (closed) and A.22-09-006 (open) and Hawaii PUC 2025 report opened; other states not checked.
caveats: Status only; no geometry or capacity in these filings.

members_summary.scope_note: Two California dockets and one Hawaii PUC report opened; utility commissions of the other states were not checked (blending pilots may exist elsewhere).

if_unstructured.summary: Planned or proposed hydrogen pipelines have no structured source: status comes from state commission dockets and construction notices, routes only from operator study figures.

local_terms.meaning: PHMSA annual report commodity group (PARTA5COMMODITY) for hydrogen pipeline systems.
NPMS commodity code for hydrogen gas.
Texas RRC commodity code under which hydrogen lines are permitted and mapped.
Texas RRC pipeline operating permit; T4PERMIT joins the RRC map layer and the hydrogen list.
PHMSA National Pipeline Mapping System and its restricted web map for officials.
Texas filing under 16 TAC §8.115 listing pipelines about to be built.
Utility pilots injecting hydrogen into isolated natural gas sections (CPUC A.22-09-006).
Private lines of industrial gas suppliers (Air Products, Linde, Air Liquide) serving refineries and chemical plants.
